title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Blood Lines
An inmate takes drastic action and leaves his cell in a bloody mess; dangerous contraband is found on another inmate at Florida's Santa Rosa Correctional Institution.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Troubled Waters
A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Unholy Trinity
Every year, close to 70,000 people are processed through the five facilities that make up the Orange County Jail in Southern California; some will call the jail home until their cases are resolved in court - a process that can take years.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Crip and the Cougar
A gang member with a violent past and a long disciplinary record in jail tries to convince staff he's changed; another inmate, once a victim of prison rape, lobbies to do his time in isolation.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Sticks and Stone
Wabash Valley Correctional Facility houses some of the highest security prisoners in the state; corrections staff investigate a potential escape plot and one inmate with a very familiar face tells their own story.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Bloodlines
A jail program attempts to save shelter dogs from being put down; an Army veteran must face his own demons; pregnant and charged with murder, one inmate must decide whether to turn in a family member to save herself.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The New Girl
Deputies respond to rising tensions in a female housing unit; a popular rapper, whose ups and downs have been told in the Oakland media, now faces serious charges; a grandmother convicted of a mortgage scam finds her place in the inmate hierarchy.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E8 — Diagnosis: Temptress Health Scam
Entrepreneur Keisha Williams is really a high-rolling shopaholic with a taste for strip clubs and exotic travel; she takes investors for millions of dollars with a can't miss bid to secure a medical money-making technology that never materializes.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E9 — The Fast and the Fraudulent
Payday loan scam mastermind, Scott Tucker, swindles millions of cash-strapped borrowers with his convenient online loan business and uses the profits to fuel his race car team dreams.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E6 — Sholam Weiss
One man's bold scheme to get rich quick; Albert Talton puts a modern twist on one of the nation's oldest crimes, making counterfeit money.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E10 — Brooklyn's Madoff; Corrupted Software
A Brooklyn investment manager starts the longest running Ponzi scheme in history; a stock trading computer program which is supposed to deliver an incredible return.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E11 — Greedy, Groovy Guru; Doomsday Profit
A new age evangelist tells Florida investors that positive thinking can lead to positive returns in her auto financing business; a man steals millions to build a luxurious doomsday bunker.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E12 — The Lady Killer
A Florida man wins millions in the lottery then disappears.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E6 — Detroit's Crime Boss Mayor
Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick and his associates extort city contractors, abuse public funds, and turn the mayor's office into their own cash machine, costing the city millions.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E15 — Streaming and Scheming
Zachary Horwitz has dreams of making it big in Hollywood; while his onscreen career never quite flourishes, Horwitz acts his way into raising more than $600 million for an investment opportunity that is completely bogus.

A crooked New York police officer cashes in as a high-tech burglary crew terrorizes homeowners and business owners.
